name: Fifth Third Mortgage / Home Equity
notes: Researched from the public Fifth Third Mortgage, Personal Loan and Auto Loan FAQs page only. Pay in online banking (Transfer and Pay > Transfer Funds or Make Payments) or the app (Move Money > Make a Payment). Automatic mortgage payments are set up and their draft date changed only by calling 800-837-2000 (autopay and autopay_cancel unsupported online with that note). Due dates cannot be changed. Payments applied effective the day received; visible next business day. Payoff by 800-972-3030; customer service 800-972-3030 M-F 8-6, Sat 10-4 ET. Hardship 866-601-6391 (repayment, forbearance, modification, short sale, deed in lieu); forbearance details 800-375-1745 option 3. Paperless, fees, cards and grace period are not on the page (family defaults; methods bank-only). Sign-in observed on secure.53.com/olb/login: User ID, Password, Log In, "Forgot Login?", "First time user? Register here". Reviewed 2026-10-10 (t20 review): sign-in labels observed; late-fee FAQ added as help. Footer pay-by-phone number set to the customer service line 800-972-3030 (the catalog record lists it as the pay-by-phone line; the public FAQ does not describe phone payments), replacing the catalog list that also showed the autopay and assistance lines.

autopay.note: Automatic mortgage payments are set up by phone: call 800-837-2000 to enroll.

autopay_cancel.note: To change or stop automatic mortgage payments, or change the draft date, call 800-837-2000.

help.title: Paying your mortgage
paragraphs: In online banking, choose Transfer and Pay, then Transfer Funds or Make Payments, pick the mortgage and follow the prompts. In the mobile app, tap Move Money and then Make a Payment.

Payments are applied effective the day we receive them. A payment received Monday to Friday between 8 a.m. and 5 p.m. ET shows online the next business day. Regular payments are applied to interest, then principal, escrow and fees; tell us if extra funds should go to principal.
Automatic payments are set up by phone at 800-837-2000. Your loan's due date cannot be changed, but the draft date of automatic payments can.

help.title: Mortgage payment assistance
paragraphs: If you cannot afford your payment, call 866-601-6391. Options, from most to least likely, include a repayment plan, a forbearance plan, a loan modification, a short sale and a deed in lieu of foreclosure. For forbearance details call 800-375-1745 and select option 3; for free counseling call HUD at 800-569-4287.

help.title: Late fees
paragraphs: A late fee is charged if we do not receive your payment by the end of the grace period. Your loan agreement shows the amount and timing, or call 800-972-3030. To dispute a late fee, call 800-972-3030 (Monday to Friday 8 a.m. to 6 p.m., Saturday 10 a.m. to 4 p.m. ET).

extra.intent: A Fifth Third mortgage borrower wants to move their loan due date to the 15th. Using the Fifth Third help pages, say whether that is possible and what they can change instead. Do not make a payment or change any settings.

solution.text: The due date cannot be changed, but the draft date of automatic payments can be changed by calling 800-837-2000.
